title: This Simple Rental Business Could Change Your Life!
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Check out my newsletter at https://TKOPOD.com and join my new community at https://TKOwners.com

I visited Martina and Aidan, the owners of Castles of Dallas, to learn how they built a bounce house rental business that anyone could copy. They started with two used inflatables off Facebook Marketplace and now rent out over 40 units, plus tables, chairs, and tents. They walked me through the numbers, how to get your first customers, what units make the most money, and why repairs and manufacturing can add extra income streams. If you want a cash-flow business you can run on weekends, this episode shows exactly how to start. 

Check them out at https://castlesofdallas.com or on Instagram and Facebook under Castles of Dallas.

Timestamps below. Enjoy!
